plan.title: Order Activity records approved award proposal

steps.note: Start a buyer-side event for the activity workflow.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Create an RFQ stage that can receive a bid and be awarded.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one line item for the vendor bid and award.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet.
Commit a usable bidding schedule.
Invite one QA vendor so the event can be published and bid on.
Publish the event before collecting a bid.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Have the invited QA vendor submit a bid, which is required before awarding.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Close the bidding window so awarding is available.
Submit the award proposal for the vendor's bid.
Confirm the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted award proposal as the buyer.
Open the stage Settings menu's Order Activity drawer.
Confirm the Order Activity drawer is open.
Confirm earlier event history remains visible.
Confirm the activity history records the approved award action.
